pressure.high.0: High pressure condenses Metal (金) energy — a time of clarity and completion. Use sharp judgment to finalize your plans.
pressure.high.1: The sky presses close, grounding heaven's energy into earth. A perfect day for deep contemplation and inner stillness.
pressure.high.2: Metal energy settles in the atmosphere. Focus on consolidating what you've built.
pressure.normal.0: Atmospheric pressure flows in harmony — the Five Elements are in balance. Let the day unfold naturally.
pressure.normal.1: The air holds the steadiness of Earth (土) energy. Stay centered and move forward with confidence.
pressure.low.0: Low pressure stirs Water (水) energy. Tides of change are rolling in — follow your intuition.
pressure.low.1: The atmosphere is restless, calling for Wood (木) energy to rise. Don't fear new challenges.
pressure.low.2: Pressure drops as Yin energy deepens. Turn inward and listen to your inner voice.
moon.newMoon.0: The new moon hides completely — Yin reaches its peak and new Yang begins to sprout. Plant the seeds of your next chapter in quiet stillness.
moon.newMoon.1: On this moonless night, Water (水) energy deepens. Retreat inward to discover your true purpose.
moon.waxingCrescent.0: The waxing crescent glows faintly — Wood (木) energy pushes up through the earth. Small beginnings lead to great things.
moon.waxingCrescent.1: As the moon begins to grow, Yang energy rises gently. A good time to crystallize your plans.
moon.firstQuarter.0: The first quarter moon — light and dark split evenly. At this crossroads of Yin and Yang, decisive action is needed.
moon.firstQuarter.1: Half the moon is revealed, placing you at a fork in the road. Let the nature of your Day Master guide your choice.
moon.waxingGibbous.0: The moon nears fullness as Fire (火) energy surges. Your energy races toward its peak.
moon.waxingGibbous.1: The nearly full moon signals that achievement is within reach. Take that final step.
moon.fullMoon.0: Under the full moon's radiance, Yang reaches its zenith. Hidden emotions and truths rise to the surface.
moon.fullMoon.1: The full moon's Fire (火) energy amplifies emotions. Maintain calm, but trust where your intuition leads.
moon.fullMoon.2: The full moon illuminates the celestial atmosphere — opportunities you couldn't see before now come into view.
moon.waningGibbous.0: The moon begins to wane, inviting Metal (金) energy. It's time to harvest and organize.
moon.waningGibbous.1: Yang retreats as Yin advances. Settle your accounts and release what's no longer needed.
moon.lastQuarter.0: The last quarter moon — light and dark balanced once more. A time for reflection: look back on the path you've walked.
moon.lastQuarter.1: The last quarter deepens Water (水) energy. Past lessons become tomorrow's compass.
moon.waningCrescent.0: The waning crescent signals the end of a cycle. Rest fully now so you can begin the next new moon with strength.
moon.waningCrescent.1: The moon has nearly vanished. Release what's old — emptying is the beginning of new fulfillment.
earthquake.quiet.0: The earth breathes quietly. The Earthly Branches (地支) are stable — a good time to build strong foundations.
earthquake.quiet.1: The ground is peaceful, filled with Earth (土) energy. Put down roots where you stand.
earthquake.moderate.0: Subtle movements stir beneath the surface. Penalty (刑) energy flows between the Earthly Branches — pause before making major decisions.
earthquake.moderate.1: Underground energy is restless. Check for small cracks in your life's foundation.
earthquake.active.0: The crust moves actively. Clash (冲) energy between Earthly Branches manifests in the physical world — stay flexible amid change.
earthquake.active.1: Strong seismic activity signals a reshuffling of the existing order. Observing is wiser than pushing forward.
earthquake.active.2: Significant earthquake activity detected. Earth's collision is heaven's warning — reinforce your foundations and strengthen from within.
weather.clear.0: Clear skies fill the air with Yang energy. Bright visibility supports sharp, clear judgment today.
weather.clear.1: A cloudless sky embodies the transparency of Fire (火) energy. Move forward with confidence under this bright outlook.
weather.clouds.0: Clouds obscure the sky — symbolically, information may be unclear. Be cautious with unverified news or rumors.
weather.clouds.1: Earth (土) energy lingers in the overcast sky. As light breaks through clouds, patience will reveal the way.
weather.rain.0: Rain brings Water (水) energy to nourish the earth. A day of emotional cleansing — wash away what burdens your heart.
weather.rain.1: Rain is a sign of heaven's grace, but excess can bring melancholy. Balance stillness with gentle activity.
weather.snow.0: Snow blankets the world in Metal (金) energy's purifying embrace. Prepare for a fresh start with a pure heart.
weather.snow.1: White snow stills all things — a symbol of Metal energy's power. Complex situations become simple to resolve.
weather.storm.0: Thunder and lightning — Wood (木) and Fire (火) collide. Prepare for sudden changes or shocking news, but know the storm will pass.
weather.storm.1: Lightning is heaven's powerful warning and purifying force. After the fury comes a clear, cleansed sky.
combo.excellent: High pressure, full moon, and quiet earth... Heaven, Earth, and Humanity (天地人) are in perfect harmony. The universe is on your side — act with courage.
combo.caution: Low pressure and active tectonics... Water (水) overflow meets Earthly Branch clashes. Observe quietly and strengthen from within today.
combo.newBeginnings: A new moon under clear skies — the transition from Yin to Yang begins. The perfect moment to set powerful new intentions.
combo.clarity: Bright moonlight and high visibility... Yang energy illuminates the world, and hidden truths will become crystal clear.
combo.grounding: Strong Earthly Branch clash (冲) energy detected deep underground. Focus on rebuilding your foundations and establishing new order.
summary.default: Heaven, Earth, and Humanity (天地人) rest in peaceful balance. Surrender to the flow of the Five Elements and follow nature's way.
summary.template: Today, with {{factors}} intertwined, the energies of heaven and earth sharpen your intuition and illuminate your path.
